data.exact_reserve_text: A favorable run-off deviation (prior accident year decrease) of GBP 0.2m (2015: GBP nil) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2014 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.
data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 were GBP 12.884m. The gross claims development triangle shows a net adverse re-estimate on prior years of approximately GBP 0.69m (driven by an upward revision to the 2014 underwriting year), equivalent to a 5.36% strengthening of opening reserves. The managing agent's note reports a small favourable run-off of GBP 0.2m on the 2014 year in relation to a Whole Account Quota Share with Syndicate 2003 (this appears to be a net/reinsurance-related figure); therefore gross and net signals differ. Primary drivers cited include run-off (claims development) and adjustments relating to quota share reinsurance arrangements.
raw_causal_phrases: A favorable run-off deviation (prior accident year decrease) of GBP 0.2m (2015: GBP nil) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2014 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.
In 2016 a large number of catastrophe losses occurred as compared to 2015 where the syndicate benefited from very low levels of attritional losses and claims for natural catastrophes.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (page 28) giving a +GBP 0.69m strengthening on the 2014 underwriting year. The managing agent's narrative (note 5, page 29) reports a "favorable run-off deviation" of GBP 0.2m on the 2014 year (likely a net/reinsurance figure). There is a discrepancy between the gross triangle (used here as the primary gross source) and the narrative/net figure; gross figure therefore calculated from triangle and flagged as an inferred calculation.
